answer_2.quote: We report the classifier-based attack success rate (ASR). ... We examine the cross-entropy loss of the first token (FT) and the average cross-entropy loss of the entire target sentence (ST).

answer_3.quote: We use the open-source classifier provided in HarmBench. This classifier is a fine-tuned Llama2-13b model, which achieves strong performance on a manually-labeled validation set.
criteria: attack success (generation of target harmful response)
